text:
alex_m: quick postmortem follow-up: root causes were rotation lag for service keys and missing audit emits. putting owners on items below — want dates + blockers.

maria_g: i can pick secrets_rotation. aim to ship automation + tests by 2026-04-18. i'll post PR and link it here.

dinesh_k: taking token_validation_fix. will add unit + integration tests. target 2026-04-01 for canary, 2026-04-02 for full roll.

jess_r: audit events owner here. building dashboard and retention policy. ETA 2026-04-22. need infra write perms.

security_ops: recommend alerting on token_age_seconds and a pre-rotation check at 30/60/90 days. we'll add recurrence rule and a weekly report.

ops_oncall: if jess_r needs perms, I can grant repo write. say the repo name.

jess_r: infra/logging please. will add queries and example alerts.

alex_m: summary (will mirror into PM doc):
- secrets_rotation -> maria_g -> 2026-04-18
- token_validation_fix -> dinesh_k -> 2026-04-02
- audit_logging_work -> jess_r -> 2026-04-22
- rotation_recurrence_alert -> security_ops -> 2026-04-10

incident-bot: Action 'secrets_rotation' assigned to maria_g (due 2026-04-18).

maria_g: initial rotation cron (will refine in PR):
```yaml
schedule: "0 2 * * 0"
job: rotate-service-keys
verify: integration-suite --tag rotation
notify: #security_ops #incidents
```

dinesh_k: CI healthcheck snippet to add: `curl -fS http://localhost:8080/health/token-validation || exit 1`. plus tests for off-by-one expiry.

jess_r: ops_oncall confirmed - granting write to jess_r on infra/logging. thanks.

security_ops: adding recurrence alert config: `alert if max(token_age_seconds) > 0.8 * token_ttl for 10m`. also adding scheduled report to #incidents every monday.

alex_m: can we also add a short post-rotation smoke test (verify tokens accepted, no 401s on service-to-service calls) to the runbook?

maria_g: yup, will add smoke steps + rollback steps to https://redwood.internal/runbooks/token-rotation.

incident-bot: Action 'token_validation_fix' status changed -> In Progress (owner: dinesh_k).

dinesh_k: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/518 (hotfix + tests). CI green, scheduling canary.

alex_m: scheduling a short sync 2026-04-06 09:30 PT to validate rollouts and dashboard queries. update tracker before that.

jess_r: pushed dashboard branch with example queries, will iterate after feedback.

alex_m: thanks everyone. we'll close when tracker shows all actions completed. :thumbsup:
